title: This Is Sparta
blurb: Gerard Butler's roar from 300 arrives with a full orchestra behind it and a Persian messenger about to discover a very deep hole. Zack Snyder's 2006 adaptation of Frank Miller's comic gave the internet several gifts, but this line is the one that never left: the ultimate declaration of territory, endlessly remixed into techno edits and dubstep drops throughout the late 2000s. It remains the default soundtrack for pushing somebody, metaphorically, into a pit. Use it to claim a room, end a negotiation, or announce that a boundary has been reached.
